notes.title: Release v2.2.0 Changelog
notes.content:
This is 2.1.0 to 2.2.0

Additions

 New map 'Titan HC Mine'

Fixes

 Miscellaneous small fixes

notes.title: Post-game Statistics Screen & AI Improvements
notes.content:
All new statistics screen shows up after the game and later you can access it again by going to "Previous Game" in the main menu. It contains this info:


 Fun title: This is calculated based on how you did, but can also be random
 Kill count
 Death count
 Total head shots
 Accuracy (%)
 Ammo used
 Damage dealt & received
 Distance ran

 
Check out the v2.1.0 change log for more details and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Release v2.1.0 Changelog
notes.content:
This is 2.0.9 to 2.1.0

Additions

 Post-game statistics calculated and shown
 Fun post-game title is given to every player. Some are based on your performance, other times they're random

Changes

 AI evaluate weapon distances differently, result is better behavior
 AI get weapons on the way to hill in King of the Hill

Fixes

 AI stutter dance is much reduced
 AI don't run to previous hill during King of the Hill
 Other small fixes

notes.title: Release v2.0.9 Changelog
notes.content:
This is 2.0.8 to 2.0.9

Additions

 Challenge games show and track progress against each challenge

Changes

 Model updates
 AI don't keep empty weapons armed
 Hold the grenade points come more slowly
 Hold the grenade points make sound
 Door sound volume reduced
 AI system gutted and replaced

Fixes

 Close combat with AI works significantly better
 B-hole specialty factions can complete all challenges without issue
 B-hole works during slow-motion mode
 AI don't stare you down from a distance... creepers
 AI much smarter during Capture the Phone mode
 Fixed movement statistics
 Many small things

notes.title: Dynamic Lighting Enabled, New Weapon, Graphics and Performance Improvements
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update, but I've been working hard on what should be some noticeable improvements.


 Dynamic lighting enabled (most apparent in gun flash, explosions and richer map details)
 New burst fire pistol: Scaver
 Character models retrofitted closer to 90's style
 Graphics engine and renderer migrated to recent versions improving overall performance

 
Also in v1.83:

  Added split-screen framing
  Map modeling improvements
  Ammo handling and reload mechanic improvements
  Spawn point improvements
  AI mechanic improvements

Check out the change log for more details and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Release v1.83 Changelog
notes.content:
This is 1.79 to 1.83

Additions

 Burst fire pistol: Scaver
 Dynamic lighting (most apparent in gun flash, explosions and richer map details)
 Black framing separating local split-screen views

Changes

 Character models retrofitted closer to 90's style (lowered poly count)
 Ammo sharing and reloading mechanics updated to more standard / typical fashion
 Earth City overall map modeling upgrade
 Hill games spawn point logic improvements 
 Rebaked (and improved) character model lighting
 Graphics engine migrated to significantly more recent version
 Renderer updated 10 major versions
 Rocket asset upgrade on Venusian map
 AI, graphics and physics performance improvements
 Weapon projectile emmission point cycling improvements 
 AI weapon decals not visible to human players are no longer created (vast performance improvement!)
 PlayStation controller warning now only shows if PlayStation controller is registered through Steam client

Fixes

 Sticky key syndrome (where key-up can sometimes seem to be not caught) resolved 
 Map specific low performance issues resolved
 AI logic improvements to reduce walking through walls and floors
 Closing or cancelling game by using Windows title bar ‘X’ stabilized
 The source of projectiles from weapons corrected to match model data
 Corrected recording of previously uncaught menu errors
 Errors now logged in English since my non-English programming skills are...lacking

notes.title: New Survival Game Mode and Revamped Paintball
notes.content:
See how long you and your friends can survive against the AI bots as they increase in difficulty every 90 seconds. 


 New Survival game mode: For each map you can beat your own or global high scores
 Opt-in Survival leaderboards added: Each battleground has its own leaderboard
 Updated gun flashes, sounds and damage in paintball mode to match how they work with paintball off. They still only leave paint splatters

 
Also in v1.78:

 Syringe gun damage decals
 Improved AI bot movement on ramps

Check out the change log for more details and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Release v1.78 Changelog
notes.content:
Additions
 Added survival gameplay mode including leaderboards for each map
 Added syringe gun decal that leaves marks where people are hit
Changes
 Updated gun flashes, sounds and damage in paintball mode to match how they work with paintball off. They still only leave paint splatters
 Disabled the window titlebar 'X' button during gameplay. Use the menus to 'Quit' mid-game
Fixes
 Improved AI bot movement so that they no longer sink into or float above ramps
 Returned the dying fade color to black
 Disabled time and point limits during High Score game mode

notes.title: New Achievements, High Score Game Mode and Leaderboards
notes.content:
Completed the first round of user requested content additions for v.1.77

 16 new Steam achievements added: Tied to beating content unlock games
 New High Score game mode (point for each NPC takedown): For each map you can beat your own or global high scores
 Opt-in high score leaderboards added: Each battleground has its own leaderboard

 
Also in v1.77:

 New weapon reload sounds
 Capture the phone player spawn logic, update
 Foam Hand unlock challenge bot configuration update
 More AI improvements
 Reset option added for Unlock games
 Texture and lighting improvements for weapons and characters
 Text resizing improvements
 Grenade throw, Map Unlock challenge, sticky key and punching bug fixes

Check out the change log for more details and keep the feedback coming!

notes.title: Release v1.77 Changelog
notes.content:
This is 1.70 to 1.77

Additions

 High Score game mode where for each map you can beat your own or global high scores
 Opt-in global leaderboards per map, for the High Score game mode
 New weapon reload sounds: Still a work in progress but they are at least different per gun now
 Options menu reset for Unlock games: Still a work in progress. Eventually you’ll be able to individually re-play the unlock challenges.

Changes

 Capture the Phone now has you spawn from within your base instead of a random spawn point
 Foam hand Unlock challenge now contains 2 enemies rather than 3 for consistency
 AI logic for capture the phone game mode improved
 Textures across all guns and heads were reworked
 Added shading for character faces: This is a small stopgap before the lighting engine gets patched and re-enabled.
 UI text auto-sizing improved and should be finalized now

Fixes

 Grenades should now always be able to be thrown (instead of sometimes staying at and exploding where the pin was pulled)
 Unlock Map challenge can now be run directly (it was throwing an error message before)
 AI can now properly shoot moving human players. The AI likely seem significantly harder now.
 Another attempt at resolving once and for all "sticky key syndrome". Please let me know if you spot the game seemingly keeping a keyboard key down after you key-up!
 Quick mouse movements should no longer cause hiccups
 Punching damage corrected. Sorry, punching is no longer ultra-powerful
 AI no longer loiter at weapon spawns

notes.title: Release v1.69 Changelog
notes.content:
This is 1.64 to 1.69

Additions

Show all teams' points when you die
Show all teams' points on the pause menu
Created a Demo version of the application
Added one-time message to suggest using DS4Windows tool until PlayStation controllers are better supported

Changes

UI text size dependent on the width of your screen or your split-screen viewport, so overall better sizing and no more text overlapping
Updated what things are called in the menus in several places
Removed the upper left watermark for release
Removed the menus screen upper right link to Playtest forums
Added main menu link to the general forum area for the game

Fixes

Can no longer see "inside" heads if you manage to align yourself with another player (scary much?)
If you kill yourself in Hold The Grenade, you no longer get to keep the grenade through your respawn
AI much less inclined to stand inside each other and you
Fixed issue where AI cannot really see human players when they're running
Even lower chance of "sticky key syndrome" where when you let up off a movement key, the movement continues
AI less inclined to loiter
Fixed issue where sometimes head and body selections would get hosed when changing or creating profiles
Improved viewport layout so less or hopefully no edge bleeding
Resolved bug where you get perfect aim during aiming
Resolved bug where some hills were unobtainable

notes.title: Release 1.63 Changelog
notes.content:
Additions
 Mouse and gamepad up/down look inversion profile setting
 Game mode (and mode description) shown on pause menu
 Game paused on gamepad disconnect
Changes
 Improved ease of aiming with keyboard/mouse
 Increased impact force from explosions and projectiles (players and objects fly further)
 Reduced inherent aiming error, increased error when repeated shots are fired
 Increased overall AI difficulty
 Improved AI logic (still under development)
 Improved UI text, text size and layout
 Hiding the AI "type" option for now (personality types not ready yet)
 Lowered global gravity (more realistic)
 Removed spawning inside the hill during King of the Hill
 Improved error reporting (if reporting is enabled)
Fixes
 AI no longer enjoy running through the walls...and other strange behavior
 Paintball decals now implemented for all weapons
 End of game window stall bug fix
 In-game total freeze bug fix
 Many small bug fixes that hopefully you didn't even notice before

notes.title: Content Update 1.63
notes.content:
Getting great feedback from testers, thanks everyone! I'm furiously implementing your input. Many additional improvements and fixes are in the pipeline, so keep an eye out for those. I'll publish an overall roadmap on the store page soon so everyone knows what development over the next couple months will look like.

Recent updates include: Mouse and gamepad up/down look inversion profile setting added (for those of you that grew up on flight sims and early consoles! N64 ftw)
 Game mode (and mode description) shown on pause menu. You're not the only one that started a game and found yourself asking - Wait...which game are we playing?
 Improved keyboard/mouse aiming experience
 Increased impact force from explosions and projectiles - Players and objects fly higher!
 Increased AI difficulty and improved AI logic
 Bug fixes for game freezes/stalls

notes.title: Content Update 1.48
notes.content:
NEW MAP RELEASE - Europa Surface MOB!

This game is all about customizing game play to your liking, so as requested I've added weapon tags to help identify the weapons you love for use in your customized loadouts. Now, whenever you pick up or switch the equipped weapon, the name is shown on your screen. 

In the pursuit of not making the game too easy, I increased the gun respawn after a repeat sniping incident from a group play through. 

More maps are in the works for the next update.

See the News Hub for more details on 1.48.
